column1: # Pinned build tools for the AppImage pipeline.
# Format (tab-separated): name <TAB> kind <TAB> url-x86_64 <TAB> url-aarch64 <TAB> sha256-x86_64 <TAB> sha256-aarch64
# kind: file   -> downloaded as-is, must be executable afterwards
#       script -> downloaded as-is, must be executable afterwards
#       tarball-> downloaded, extracted, inner binary expected at <name>
# sha256 "-" means unpinned for that arch: the build warns loudly and proceeds
# only when ALLOW_UNPINNED_TOOLS=1 is set. Keep pins current by re-downloading
